messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposal to squeeze the left rail by collapsing the Models/Routes group into a single 'Workloads' entry. Trying to free vertical space for breadcrumbs and the quick-actions strip. Sketch idea: 3-level nav -> top-level Workloads -> type tabs -> item list. Thoughts?

aj: I like freeing vertical real estate but worried about discoverability for Models. Can we add a pinned 'Models' result in global search and surface a shortlabel in the crumb? :thinking_face:

sam: Agree on space. Two engineering constraints: 1) deep links must remain stable; 2) we need a migration path for old URLs. Proposed canonical pattern: `/app/:org/workloads/:type/:id`. Keep `/app/:org/models/:id` as a redirect (301/replace history) to `/workloads/models/:id` for backwards compat.

taylor: Accessibility nit: when groups collapse, keyboard focus should land on the group header (not lost). Add a visible skip-link `Skip to main content` that becomes visible on keyboard focus when the left nav is compact. Also ensure the breadcrumb uses `aria-current="page"` on the last crumb and `role="navigation" aria-label="Breadcrumb"`.

maria: For breadcrumbs UX I propose: workspace > workload-type > item short title. Long names get ellipsis and show full name on hover/tooltip. Also allow direct deep-linking into collapsed list items — route opens the collapsed group, animates expand, and focuses the item in the list (but don't auto-scroll the page unexpectedly).

aj: Small UX ask: when deep-linking in to a collapsed section, animate the expand + focus but avoid jumpiness — prefer a 200ms ease and keep scroll position. Also keep history clean (one pushState, don't spam entries when animation runs).

sam: Dev note: router middleware sketch for the redirect (very small):
```
// on route change
if (path.startsWith('/app/' + org + '/models/')) {
  const id = extractId(path)
  router.replace(`/app/${org}/workloads/models/${id}`)
  telemetry.track('redirect.models.to.workloads', {from: path})
}
```
Also: persist `route.name` telemetry so old dashboards keep reporting correctly.

taylor: A11y checklist TODO (I'll write up): keyboard flow for collapsed nav, visible focus ring on group headers, skip-link, screenreader announcement when nav expands (use `aria-live="polite"`), and test with NVDA + VoiceOver.

maria: Ok sounds like rough consensus. I'll update the IA doc and attach a tiny prototype gif demonstrating the expand/focus animation. Follow-ups: @taylor please author the accessibility checklist, @sam please prototype the redirect middleware and router tests, @aj please run the discoverability checks with search. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
